final_script:
User story: "As a customer browsing https://www.saucedemo.com, I want the product list to display complete product cards so that I can compare items. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', the inventory page shows exactly 6 product cards '.inventory_item'; every card contains a name element '.inventory_item_name' with non-empty text and a price element '.inventory_item_price' whose text starts with '$'."

Complexity: medium
